sec-hardening.title: Security & Privacy Hardening
sec-hardening.description: Holistic security review 后的改进计划。修复边界放置与权限组合问题: intent 控制平面、捕获层隐私拦截、secret 存储、日志 PII、密码字段脱敏、shell blocklist、InsecureSsl、AppClassifier 失败模式。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

sec-intent-lockdown.title: P0.1 关闭导出 Intent 控制平面
sec-intent-lockdown.description: Production build 忽略外部 caller 的安全敏感 intent extras (API key, base URL, backend, mode, debug/trace flags)。永不持久化 intent 提供的凭据。外部 goal 需用户确认。Debug build 保留现有行为。
acceptCriteria: External ACTION_MAIN launch cannot persist API keys or routing changes
External launch cannot force BASIC mode
External launch cannot auto-start agent without user confirmation
Debug build debug workflow unaffected
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sec-fail-closed-secrets.title: P0.3 Secret 存储关闭式失败
sec-fail-closed-secrets.description: 移除明文 SharedPreferences fallback。加密存储失败时仅保持内存中凭据, 显示降级横幅。loadApiKeyFromFile() 用 BuildConfig.DEBUG 门控。清理相关 deadcode (prefsFailed flag, plaintext prefs init)。加 test。
acceptCriteria: No long-lived secret written to plain SharedPreferences
Encryption failure visible to user via degraded-security banner
Current-session credentials work in memory without persistence
Production build has no path reading api_key.txt from shared storage
Related deadcode (prefsFailed, plaintext init) removed
./gradlew test passes

sec-remove-auth-pii.title: P0.4 移除 auth PII 日志
sec-remove-auth-pii.description: 删除 OpenAIOAuth.kt 中 id_token claims 日志和 OpenAiSignIn.kt 中 email 日志。如需调试仅记录 token 存在与长度, 受 BuildConfig.DEBUG 门控。LlmLogger 已有 DEBUG 门控, 无需改动。
acceptCriteria: No token claims, emails, or account identifiers in logcat
grep -rn 'id_token claims' app/src/main/kotlin/ returns empty
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sec-capture-privacy-gate.title: P0.2 捕获层隐私拦截 (TDD)
sec-capture-privacy-gate.description: 将 blocked-app masking 移入捕获栈, 在任何制品创建之前执行。BLOCKED app 立即返回遮罩 snapshot, 不写入 raw/sanitized tree 或截图, 不发出含捕获内容的 post-action observation。统一 post-action capture 路径。用 /tdd 先写 test 再改代码。
acceptCriteria: Tracing on a blocked app writes no screenshot or tree artifact
open_app and UIActionInvocation cannot return raw blocked-app observations
Blocked-app session produces only masked snapshots and policy warnings
./gradlew test passes

sec-shell-blocklist.title: P1.2 Shell blocklist 精简
sec-shell-blocklist.description: 将 ShellTool BLOCKED_COMMANDS 从 14 个精简为 4 个: am, pm, reboot, su。解除 rm, mv, cp, chmod, chown, sh, bash, eval, exec, settings。不限制元字符, 不添加 path denylist。
acceptCriteria: BLOCKED_COMMANDS contains exactly: am, pm, reboot, su
rm, mv, cp, settings and other previously blocked commands are allowed
Shell metacharacters (pipe, redirect, subshell) unrestricted
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sec-insecure-ssl-debug.title: P1.3 InsecureSsl 编译时 Debug-only
sec-insecure-ssl-debug.description: 将 InsecureSslConfig.kt 移至 debug/ source set, release source set 提供 no-op stub。验证 base URL 覆盖在 debug 之外要求 HTTPS。
acceptCriteria: InsecureSslConfig.kt exists only in debug/ source set
Release build cannot compile any insecure TLS helper
Production base URL rejects non-HTTPS URLs
./gradlew assembleRelease passes

sec-classifier-fail-closed.title: P1.4 AppClassifier 关闭式失败
sec-classifier-fail-closed.description: fromAssets() 在 app_tiers.json 加载失败时抛异常而非返回空分类器。Session 创建中止并向用户展示错误。不添加特殊 escape action 路径。
acceptCriteria: Missing/corrupt app_tiers.json prevents session start
User sees error explaining the issue
No empty-classifier fallback path in production code
./gradlew test passes

sec-password-suppression.title: P1.1 密码字段脱敏 (isPassword)
sec-password-suppression.description: 在 Perceptor 构建 PerceptionElement 时检查 AccessibilityNodeInfo.isPassword(), 为 true 则抑制 text/contentDescription。所有下游路径自动继承。不做 editable 字段抑制、不拆分 serializer。
acceptCriteria: Password fields never appear with raw text in prompt/history/trace
Non-password fields (including editable) unchanged
./gradlew test passes

sec-data-retention.title: P2.2 数据留存控制
sec-data-retention.description: 在 Settings → Permissions & Advanced 页面新增 Data & Storage section。提供 session history/checkpoints/memory/trace 留存设置、一键安全擦除、默认关闭 trace 并启用时给出提示。
acceptCriteria: Data & Storage section visible in Permissions & Advanced settings
One-tap wipe for traces and stored sessions works
Trace defaults to off with clear messaging when enabled
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

sec-regression-tests.title: P2.3 安全回归测试
sec-regression-tests.description: 为所有 security hardening items 编写回归测试。主要为 JVM unit test, 仅 blocked-app trace test 需要 instrumentation test。
acceptCriteria: Test: external intent with sensitive extras ignored in production
Test: blocked app produces no trace screenshots/trees
Test: password fields redacted from prompt/history/trace
Test: encrypted storage failure does not persist secrets in plaintext
Test: shell blocklist contains only am/pm/reboot/su
Test: AppClassifier load failure prevents session start
./gradlew test passes
